REVIEW_DECISION: REJECT
RISK_CLASS: high-impact
SUMMARY: The governance prose requires independent Sol and Opus approval, but the provenance schema proves only that two profile-name patterns occur. It does not require distinct review artifacts or reviewer attempts, so one review can be relabeled and counted twice. This permits a high-impact contract change to appear accepted without two independent approvals.
FINDING: high|docs/factory-ng/schemas/factory.change-provenance-v1.schema.json|High-impact reviews need not have distinct review IDs, digests, attempts, or reviewer identities|This fails the mandatory independent Sol-and-Opus approval contract and allows immutable provenance to overstate approval
REQUIRED_CHANGE: Require separately identified Sol and Opus review records with distinct immutable review/attempt identities and digests; enforce cross-record distinctness in the validator and add a failing duplicate-review fixture.
COUNTEREXAMPLE: An accepted high-impact provenance record with reviewer_profile values codex-sol-review@1 and claude-opus-review@1 but review_sha256 set to sha256:same in both entries passes the schema despite representing only one review artifact.
